Add in-memory rental service for boards and sails

createRentalService() keeps equipment and bookings in memory. quote()
prices a whole-day UTC period in euro cents; book() reserves the item
and refuses overlapping periods. Back-to-back periods do not overlap.
Cancellation is deliberately not implemented yet.
